name: zoteus
description: Your Zotero library inside Claude: search by keyword or meaning, quote PDF passages with page numbers, format citations in any CSL style, add papers by DOI or arXiv id, and organize with reversible writes.

zotero_api_key.title: Zotero API key (optional)
zotero_api_key.description: Leave empty to work through the running Zotero desktop app with no key. Add a key from https://www.zotero.org/settings/keys for sync, group libraries, metadata edits, tags and collections, and for when the app is closed.
